race.comment: DAMAS (3) has the most persuasive profile, easing out of a Sandown-Lakeside mid-week 3yo+ BM70 where he was fourth, after making ground from back in the field. A close second in a Coffs Harbour trial adds to the sense he is ready to improve second-up, and the 1.5kg claim helps. SAVOCA (9) is the main danger after a BM66 win at Quirindi and a fourth at Scone, gets significant weight relief and poses a big threat. BUCK PHAROAH (2) resumes from a long break but is a proven Port Macquarie track-and-distance horse, reunites with Aaron Bullock and poses a genuine danger on best efforts. THE PICCOLINO (12) was poor last start at Tuncurry, but his previous second on soft ground and the return to a shorter trip give him genuine place appeal. DENIAL (7) strips fitter fourth-up and is in the mix.
